decisions.summary: One margin seated once; the ladder only for a margin that seats no house (no lawful exit bearing or field corridor); a margin seating some but not all refused with SiteRefused; rescue, withheld re-seat, early stop and the 12:1 refusal removed, the declared shape still recorded
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-004, FR-005 and FR-006 as written: a pre-start skip seats no house so nothing is taken back, and a partial seating is refused rather than reseated elsewhere. The GM: get rid of this pattern completely.

decisions.summary: Growth queues and settles seats with no radius test and keeps widening past GROW_LEVELS (16 directions, rings stepping out) until a level queues no new seat on the canvas; the old radius stays only where it sizes other things
decisions.why: FR-002: the radius refuses no seat; the GM: keep placing houses outside the boundary. The termination answers FR-005's 'no free ground on the map' with a lattice of ring points, an approximation that SC-003 and the cohort (FR-009) measure; that is a design matter, not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: FIELD_REACH_FT and within_field_reach deleted with their four calls; seat window, free-ground grid box and free_seats' box become the canvas; site_boundary.window records the seat center only; legend and tests updated; ways/law.py's own constant untouched
decisions.why: FR-003 and SC-002; the GM: get rid of these 700 feet measurement completely. Measured: the grep shows exactly the four predicate calls plus the stages/boundary/capacity uses the plan names. The window recording the center rather than a box 'sized from the map's own extent' (FR-003's words) removes the figure either way; the spec's sentence should be reconciled with it, but it narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Growth heap keyed by distance to the field's facing chains instead of distance from the margin center, level structure unchanged; unit test pins the order
decisions.why: FR-003a and SC-002a verbatim: nearest the field first among a level's offers, the level-by-level widening kept so the cluster stays tight. The GM: take the one that is closer to the fields.

decisions.summary: recheck_passages keeps only its in-place arm (a passage the finished map makes unnecessary ended, no house moved); relay, stored layouts and passage_unfit removed
decisions.why: FR-001 and US2 scenario 2 as accepted: the re-lay is a take-back and goes; the in-place ending moves no house and holds page 0081's condition.

decisions.summary: Quarter-built figure recorded per nucleated map as meta.built_share (houses, yards, gardens, groves inside the convex hull of homestead boxes), refusing nothing
decisions.why: FR-007; the GM chose 'floor soft'. Premise measured: no engine file names a built share or quarter-built rule, and page 0032's drawing page says hamlets are exempt and no village is laid out by chance today, so reporting is all there is to do.

decisions.summary: Drawing pages 0029, 0032 and 0081 rewritten as US3 states; claims citing the reach removed with their code; impl-drift on changed units
decisions.why: FR-008 and US3 scenarios 1-3; the GM's preference recorded as canon.

decisions.summary: Declared occasions: placement-changed farmhouse on the nucleated pool maps (Inashiro, Kuwabata, Sawada) and village lane where houses move
decisions.why: Review process, not the GM's request; automatic occasions (a glyph re-placed) still fire on any other map the removal of the reach moves.

decisions.summary: The regression check runs make cohort N=24 with the pool against main
decisions.why: SC-005/FR-009 name 'the cohort'; N=24 is the project's standing cohort run (every recent feature's spec uses it) and includes seed 18. The 30-seed census is FR-005's premise, a separate measurement already taken.
